selection: mean of target MAE / rank-median MAE over all ranked development players
tie_break: original preregistered recipe order; absolute score difference <= 1e-12
selection_scope: Previously inspected ranked games, including the phase-one ranked holdout, are now development data only.

uncertainty.limitation: Descriptive bands from the same ranked development data used for model selection; not independent conformal calibration or a coverage guarantee.

development_error_analysis.slice_warning: Descriptive correlated slices; small groups do not establish an improvement.

final_test_policy: Freeze this result and candidate hashes before opening unseen retrospective ranked games from the separately registered window. This is an independent historical check, not forward-time evidence. Never retune or change the selected recipe on these scores.
limitations: Development scores are selection-biased and are not independent evidence of improved accuracy.
The first experiment and its failed transfer result remain unchanged.
Pro-trained resource forecasts are not causal impact scores or optimal-action labels.
